items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: The remaining part of the band was taken over by Joseph Phillips, trumpet player. That group was called Joseph Phillips' Orchestra. And after about two years, William Houston, the pianist in Sidney Desvines band, bought out the ownership from Joe Phillips.

ctx.x: You string your banjo and guitar opposite then too.

Yes. And I started on the bass violin and played that and I continued on playing the bass violin. And I joined Sidney Desvines band again in 1941 and played with him until 47. And that band broke up. Then the Four Tones came in. That was Fred Minor, he was playing guitar in Sidney Desvines band. Louis Barberand was playing drums. And Alvin Alcorn playing trumpet. So we organized a group and called them the Four Tones. We played for two, three years together. And the remaining part of the band was taken over by…
That's after Sidney Desvines already gave up in...
